# Baseline profile
#
# Tells ART which code to compile ahead of time at install. Without it every Compose code
# path runs interpreted until the JIT catches up, which is exactly the first few seconds
# after a cold start -- the point at which the station list is first scrolled.
#
# Hand-written, so it is deliberately broad rather than precise: whole packages instead of
# the individual methods a generated profile would name. The cost is a larger compiled
# footprint at install time. A profile generated by a Macrobenchmark run on a real device
# would be tighter and slightly faster still; this is what can be had without one.
#
# Format: H = hot, S = startup, P = post-startup. ** matches any package, class or signature.

# The app itself
HSPLcom/jamal2367/urlradio/**->**(**)**

# Compose. The runtime, the layout/draw pipeline and the lazy list are the hot paths a
# scroll goes through on every frame.
HSPLandroidx/compose/runtime/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/ui/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/foundation/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/animation/**->**(**)**
HSPLandroidx/compose/material3/**->**(**)**

# Station artwork is decoded while the list is being scrolled for the first time.
HSPLcoil3/**->**(**)**

# Collection parsing on startup, and the coroutine machinery every load goes through.
HSPLcom/google/gson/**->**(**)**
HSPLkotlinx/coroutines/**->**(**)**
